Row Grain: One federal election contest
Purpose: Identifies each ingested contest by year, office/chamber, electoral method, seat count, and term length.
Notes: Covers PRE, DIP MR, and SEN MR contests across 1994-2024; see README for the cycle matrix.

Row Grain: One normalized geography combination within one election
Purpose: Stores election-scoped state, section, municipio, federal-district, and circunscripcion attributes.
Notes: The composite key prevents geography from being incorrectly shared across cycles with different boundaries or assignments.

Row Grain: One source municipio representation within one election
Purpose: Maps election-cycle municipio representations to INEGI GeoJSON features with an auditable review trail.
Notes: Exact matches and overrides can receive CVEGEO; unresolved or ambiguous rows retain suggestions without applying them.

Row Grain: One casilla or acta within one election
Purpose: Stores polling-station identifiers and operational attributes used to link vote facts to geography.
Notes: The composite key is required because casilla identifiers can repeat across elections.

Row Grain: One normalized electoral vote option
Purpose: Stores party, coalition, independent-candidate, and historical source-era vote-option keys.
Notes: A party_key is an electoral vote option and does not necessarily represent one legally independent party.

Row Grain: One candidate catalog row for an election type/party/geography combination
Purpose: Stores candidate catalog information available from the 2015, 2021, and 2024 clean cycles.
Notes: The table stores election_type rather than election_id; candidate availability differs by cycle and office.

Row Grain: One party vote total within one election and casilla
Purpose: Stores normalized long-format federal election results.
Key Foreign Keys: election_id -> dim_election.election_id; party_key -> dim_party.party_key; election_id+casilla_id -> dim_casilla
Notes: UNIQUE(election_id, casilla_id, party_key); null and non-registered totals repeat across party rows and require the aggregation pattern documented in the table dictionary.

Row Grain: One Mexican federal entity
Purpose: Stores researched state-executive, local-congress, and municipal election-cycle metadata.
Notes: The source field records the research vintage; future election years should be refreshed as official calendars change.

Row Grain: One normalized polling house
Purpose: Stores polling-house names and optional organization type and family labels used by presidential-approval observations.
Notes: pollster_name is unique; familia groups spelling or branding variants without changing the original house name.

Row Grain: One source document or article
Purpose: Stores provenance for approval-poll observations and topic evaluations.
Notes: source_ref is unique and may point to a report PDF or a web article; retrieval time records when the source was captured.

Row Grain: One presidential approval observation from one pollster in one month
Purpose: Stores approval, disapproval, residual share, method, source, and extraction provenance for presidential polling.
Notes: occurrence distinguishes multiple observations by the same pollster in a month; percentages are stored as 0-100 values.

Row Grain: One issue-evaluation observation from one pollster in one month
Purpose: Stores public evaluations of named policy topics reported alongside approval polling.
Notes: tema preserves the reported topic label, while tema_politica holds an optional normalized policy taxonomy key.

Row Grain: One Cámara de Diputados Gaceta roll-call vote
Purpose: Stores source, legislature, period, date, title, status, and contextual metadata for Cámara votes.
Notes: Separate from electoral contests in dim_election.

Row Grain: One deputy identity observed in Gaceta roll calls
Purpose: Stores the normalized identity domain used by individual Cámara vote facts.
Notes: dim_diputados provides the audited bridge from official INE seats to these observed identities.

Row Grain: One official 2024 Cámara seat assignment
Purpose: Stores all MR and RP seats and bridges official INE candidate identities to Gaceta identities.
Notes: Contains 300 MR and 200 RP seats; uncertain or missing-name mappings may remain NULL.

Row Grain: One reported summary cell for a Cámara vote
Purpose: Stores Gaceta summary counts by vote choice and parliamentary group.
Notes: Includes reported Total rows/columns; party_key represents a parliamentary group in this context.

Row Grain: One deputy observation on one Cámara vote
Purpose: Stores individual Cámara roll-call choices and time-specific parliamentary affiliation.
Notes: The current SQLite schema enforces the composite primary key but does not declare these logical foreign keys.

Row Grain: One classification per classified Cámara vote
Purpose: Stores topical and procedural labels with evidence, deterministic review status, review notes, and model/prompt lineage.
Notes: The current workflow targets Legislature 66 and deliberately excludes model self-confidence.

Row Grain: One Senado roll-call vote
Purpose: Stores source metadata, legislative period, description, vote type, and reported totals for Senado votes.
Notes: Current data covers Legislature LXVI roll calls scraped from senado.gob.mx.

Row Grain: One senator identity observed in Senado roll calls
Purpose: Stores the normalized identity domain used by individual Senado vote facts.
Notes: The observed roster can exceed the 128-seat chamber because substitutions and membership changes occur over time.

Row Grain: One official 2024 Senado seat assignment
Purpose: Stores all MR, first-minority, and RP seats and bridges official INE identities to observed Senado identities.
Notes: Contains 64 MR, 32 FM, and 32 RP seats; match method and score make identity resolution auditable.

Row Grain: One senator observation on one Senado vote
Purpose: Stores normalized individual Senado roll-call choices, source-detail text, and time-specific parliamentary group.
Notes: The current SQLite schema enforces the composite primary key but does not declare these logical foreign keys.

Row Grain: One semantic classification per classified Senate vote
Purpose: Stores model-produced origin, stage, instrument, topic, confidence, review flag, evidence, and prompt/model lineage.
Notes: Optional and independently reproducible; reviewed CSV results are applied explicitly.

Row Grain: One official chamber roster observation
Purpose: Stores cutoff and source provenance for current Cámara and Senado directories.
Notes: Roster freshness is separate from the roll-call cutoff.

Row Grain: One constitutional seat in one roster snapshot
Purpose: Stores current occupant and parliamentary group alongside the immutable election identity and party.
Notes: A missing in-office member is represented explicitly as VACANTE; Cámara LICENCIA markers are preserved.

Row Grain: One unchanged occupant/status interval for one constitutional seat
Purpose: Collapses append-only roster snapshots into non-overlapping observed occupancy episodes.
Notes: valid_from is the first observed cutoff; it does not claim an earlier legal start date.

Row Grain: One observed party episode within one source series
Purpose: Stores official-directory and vote-reported party histories without overwriting electoral ownership.
Notes: Source series remain separate; conflicting same-day vote labels are counted for QA.

Row Grain: One Cámara de Diputados initiative
Purpose: Stores who proposed each initiative, its committee referral, and a link to the resulting vote when one exists.
Notes: Separate source page tree from dim_gaceta_vote (/Gaceta/Iniciativas/ vs /Gaceta/Votaciones/); proposer_type is legislador/ejecutivo/minuta/otro, with needs_review=1 flagging unmatched proposer text.

Row Grain: One Senado initiative
Purpose: Stores who proposed each initiative and its committee referral, from senado.gob.mx's Listado de Asuntos Publicados tool.
Notes: Legislature LXVI only, and only the tipo=Inic (legislator-authored) feed; no vote join exists yet, unlike dim_gaceta_iniciativa.
